title: High altitude hike
text: Thoroughly enjoyable hike led by a highly professional, friendly and knowledgeable guide who paced the walk perfectly to suit the whole party. Beautiful views throughout.
author: johnlH2749TB

title: October 2026
text: Jaime and his adorable dog, Kai were incredible guides. It was a beautiful day (9-4:30) exploring the Sierra Nevadas. I enjoyed meeting my fellow group members and learning more about the geology of the area. I know many people wonder if they can do the hike, I'd say if you regularly hike or do cardio, you'll be fine. If not, it might be slower and more challenging, but we did take a lot of breaks.
author: O1611TIlisag

title: A transformative experience with the best guide and guidedog
text:
This hike has become a core memory to me to say the least. 

I saw that it said beginner friendly, but was very nervous because I did not bring hiking shoes nor trainers (I was in soft sneakers), and I’m practically a novice when it comes to hiking and I have exercise-induced asthma plus a fear of heights. Even thought about not going because I did not want to be a hindrance. But I am so glad I went.

author: 673gigiy

title: Amazing Hike
text:
We really enjoyed the hike with Jaime! We felt very welcome and it just like hiking with friends. Kai the dog helped guide us and provided constant entertainment. Beautiful scenery and we were able to see many different species of animals and plants which Jaime explained to us. The hike was at a great pace and was adapted to the group. We were never rushed and were able to take our time and rest when needed.

author: gemmahO702HR

title: Mountain hiking with fantastic views
text: Great trip in the mountain region with fantastic views over open landscape. A warm break from the tourist machine and the heat in Granada. The guide Jaime is knowledgeable, talkative, and a pleasant person to be on a tour with. Recommended.
author: 445larsk

title: Great views.
text: Great hike. I am 60 and have a dodgy knee so that combined with the altitude made this hike a little challenging for me. It’s subjective though - ten years ago it would have been easy. Views were amazing.
author: KathHadleigh

title: Great
text:
Superb hike of medium difficulty that offers magnificent views. It remains very accessible if you are at least a little athletic and ready to provide a continuous effort without stopping every 10 meters.
​The route is very well thought out thanks to two checkpoints: the first allows you to return to the truck in case of giving up, and the second to cut the end of the climb to catch up with the group at the time of the descent.

author: Excursion32629837795

title: An amazing hike with a wonderful, knowledgeable guide
text: Jamie was a wonderful guide that took us on a wonderful trail off the beaten path so we really got to experience the beauty and solitude of the Sierra Nevada park. You can tell he loves the area and is very knowledgable about the flora, fauna and geologic history. And we absolutely loved his dog! We saw various bird species, and both male and female ibex. 100% recommend.
author: DirkH315

title: Fresh air - good guide.
text: Very nice experience, good and helpful guide, but be aware, that it requieres some physical capabilities.
author: Michael_M

title: Amazing and challenging 10/10
text:
Very difficult for non-hikers so be warned but Jamie can provide everything you should need, you just need to ask ahead of time.

That said, it was totally worth it and one of the coolest travel experiences I’ve ever done. 10/10
